violation_type.title: Documentation for Directors (26 TAC §744.1037(a))
violation_type.typical_finding: Provider did not submit new director documentation for site director. The documents were requested to  be submitted by 9/17/2026. A new controlling person was submitted for a new site director. Director qualification, Governing body form and personal history statement was not submitted.
